descriptor: Calendar and focus app for freelancers

voice.summary: Talks like a freelancer friend who has been burned by hidden fees: clear on price, relaxed about choosing. It states the cost per period and leaves the decision with you.
dos: Show price per month and per year side by side
Say exactly what each plan includes
donts: Avoid vague phrases like best value

taglines: Simple pricing. Pick how you pay
A calendar that keeps your rhythm
boilerplate: Cadence is a calendar and focus app for freelancers that keeps tasks, schedule and deep-work time in one place, with monthly, annual and lifetime plans.

microcopy.error: We couldn't update your plan. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No plan chosen yet. Pick how you want to pay.

logo.note: A steady pulse line reflects rhythm and cadence.
